fusions.name: Pinned to the Floor
fusions.desc: A sweeping head-blow that deals 15 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Levelling Plunge
fusions.desc: Hurls a crushing column of water that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, and every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it takes 80% of that.

fusions.name: Wide-Set Senses
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Anvil Skull
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.
